tasks.label: Mobile-Vibe-Monitor · 随开随关
tasks.detail: 当 VS Code 打开此文件夹时静默拉起监控服务；关窗时 VS Code 自动杀掉该后台任务
tasks.command: if not exist .vibe_env\Scripts\python.exe (python -m venv .vibe_env && .vibe_env\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --quiet --upgrade pip && .vibe_env\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --quiet fastapi "uvicorn[standard]" watchdog psutil) & .vibe_env\Scripts\python.exe vibe_server.py

tasks.label: 终止 Mobile-Vibe-Monitor (释放 8000 端口)
tasks.detail: 强制杀掉占用 8000 端口的进程，用于手动关停服务
tasks.command: for /f "tokens=5" %a in ('netstat -ano ^| findstr :8000 ^| findstr LISTENING') do @taskkill /F /PID %a 2>nul & echo [✓] Mobile-Vibe-Monitor 已停止
